## Current Roles & Leadership
- **IT Secretary & Lead Platform Architect** at **Nabodigonto Social Welfare Organization** (Dec 2024 – Present):
  - Promoted to the executive board as IT Secretary after designing and deploying the organization's flagship digital platform.
  - Architected the Blind Audit Protocol with double-signed treasury verification, masking ledger balances until dual-officer sign-off.
  - Designed dynamic 3D-flip digital member ID cards with public QR verification and automated PVC print layouts.
  - Reduced administrative reporting time by 80% with automated dues tracking and SHA-256 verified PDF audit exports.
